bulk.title: Bulk Day Selection
bulk.intro: Choose criteria according to your own approach and pick a colour; matching new days are added to your draft selection in that colour. The criteria and colour are not saved; only the resulting days can be stored.
bulk.colorHint: The colour you choose is applied only to days newly added by this bulk action; it does not change the colour of existing days.

newDialog.title: Create / Open Calendar
newDialog.intro: Choose the year and month. If you already have a calendar for that year, it opens (no new one is created); otherwise one is created. The editing screen for that month then opens.
newDialog.existing: You already have a calendar for {year} (“{name}”). No new calendar is created; {month} {year} opens with its existing marked days, colours and notes.
newDialog.missing: You do not have a calendar for {year} yet. {month} {year} opens empty; you mark the days yourself.

ws.emptyBody: Choose the year and month; mark your application days yourself on that month's editing screen.
ws.introOwn: This calendar is your working plan. You decide your application days according to your own approach.
ws.introHow: Yaşam Sistemi does not add predefined application days to the calendar. The calendar below shows your saved calendar (read-only; tapping a day opens its information). To change days, use Edit This Month or + Create / Open Calendar (year/month).
ws.editingHint: Tap a day to add/edit it; press Save Changes to make it permanent.
ws.wordAnnualTitle: Download the annual calendar (12 months) as Word
ws.hintEdit: Tap a day to add/edit it (choosing a colour is required)
ws.hintView: Tap a day to see its information (read-only)
ws.footerNote: Note: This calendar is your personal working plan; it is not an appointment system. You decide the application days according to your own approach; Yaşam Sistemi does not add predefined days to the calendar. You define what the colours mean.
